us.label: US News
us.subtitle: Top domestic headlines from the last 1–2 days

articles.title: Prosecutors say engraved bullet shows Charlie Kirk was politically targeted
bullets: Prosecutors cited an engraved bullet in arguing the defendant targeted Kirk for perceived politics.
The case has intensified national attention on political violence and security at public events.
Authorities are pursuing the case through the criminal courts.

articles.title: Amazon plans drone delivery expansion to 500 US cities
bullets: Amazon said it is preparing to expand lightweight package delivery by drone.
The plan would bring drone delivery service to many more US customers this year.
The expansion comes as retailers compete on faster last-mile delivery.

articles.title: Byron Donalds wins GOP nomination for Florida governor
bullets: US Rep. Byron Donalds won the Republican nomination for Florida governor.
He is set to face former US Rep. David Jolly, the Democratic nominee.
The race will test Donald Trump’s influence in his adopted home state.

articles.title: Alaska Senate race shifts toward Sullivan-Peltola general election matchup
bullets: Sen. Dan Sullivan and former US Rep. Mary Peltola advanced from Alaska’s primary.
The contest is expected to be a closely watched US Senate race.
Both campaigns are turning toward November’s general election.

articles.title: Indiana flooding death toll reaches at least seven
bullets: Officials reported at least seven deaths after days of heavy rain and flooding in Indiana.
Flooding damaged communities and prompted emergency responses.
Authorities continued assessing conditions after record-setting rainfall.

global.label: Global
global.subtitle: Top worldwide stories and geopolitical developments

articles.title: Ukraine launches nearly 800 drones at Russia as missile strike kills 10 in Kharkiv region
bullets: Russia said its air defenses intercepted 791 Ukrainian drones overnight.
More than 600 drones were directed toward the Moscow region, officials said.
A Russian missile strike on a Kharkiv-region village killed at least 10 people and wounded 17.

articles.title: Trump threatens Oman over emerging Iran Strait of Hormuz deal
bullets: Regional officials said Trump threatened Oman over its talks with Iran on Hormuz shipping management.
The US is objecting to parts of a not-yet-announced Iran-Oman arrangement.
The Strait of Hormuz remains central to global oil and gas flows.

articles.title: Ukraine anti-corruption agencies probe senior officials in Zelenskyy’s office
bullets: Ukrainian anti-corruption agencies are investigating senior officials in President Zelenskyy’s office.
The probe adds political pressure during Ukraine’s war with Russia.
A fired defense minister has demanded elections.

articles.title: United Arab Emirates suspends trade with Iran after renewed missile fire
bullets: The UAE suspended trade with Iran after coming under renewed missile fire.
The move marks another escalation around the Gulf and Strait of Hormuz.
Regional tensions continue to disrupt commerce and shipping.

articles.title: Israeli military opens criminal probes into Hind Rajab and paramedic killings
bullets: Israel’s military said it will investigate the killings of Hind Rajab and Palestinian paramedics.
The cases drew international scrutiny over civilian deaths in Gaza.
The investigations are being handled as criminal probes.

articles.title: Early warning systems remain India’s first defense against climate disasters
bullets: AP reported on how Indian fishing communities rely on early warnings before cyclones.
Timely alerts can determine whether deep-sea crews return safely.
The story focuses on disaster preparedness along India’s coast.

articles.title: India’s ‘Mangrove Man’ works to protect sinking shores
bullets: The report profiles conservation work to restore and protect mangroves in India.
Mangroves help buffer coastal communities against storms and erosion.
Local restoration efforts are tied to livelihoods and climate resilience.

articles.title: Cyclone-hit Indian hamlet looks to sea wall for protection
bullets: A coastal Indian village is looking to a sea wall after cyclone damage.
Residents face recurring risks from storms, erosion and rising seas.
The story highlights adaptation choices for vulnerable communities.

articles.title: Indian residents try to save a river as officials deny problems
bullets: Residents in India are organizing around concerns over a threatened river.
Officials have denied or disputed the scale of the problem.
The dispute shows tensions between local environmental concerns and government responses.

articles.title: Rising salinity creates daily water struggle on India’s shore
bullets: Coastal residents are facing saltwater intrusion into water supplies.
Rising salinity has made daily access to usable water harder.
The issue is linked to climate stress and coastal change.

articles.title: AI-linked stocks sell off; US futures open flat
bullets: S&P 500 futures were little changed while Nasdaq futures slipped 0.1%.
Oracle fell more than 1% premarket; Marvell and Intel dropped nearly 2%.
Micron also dipped after being a major drag on the S&P 500 Tuesday.

articles.title: S&P 500, Nasdaq and Dow fall as AI stocks weigh on indexes
bullets: The S&P 500 fell 0.7% Tuesday, its third straight modest loss.
The Dow slipped 0.2%, while the Nasdaq dropped 1.3%.
Nvidia, Micron and Broadcom were among the heaviest weights on the market.

articles.title: Micron drops 7% as AI trade weakens
bullets: Micron Technology fell 7% in Tuesday trading.
The memory-chip maker was one of the biggest drags on the S&P 500.
AI-linked hardware stocks continued to face valuation concerns.

articles.title: Rising oil prices pressure US stocks and bond yields
bullets: US stocks edged lower Monday after oil prices rose.
Brent crude rose 2.7% to $90.87 a barrel.
The 10-year Treasury yield climbed to 4.72% from 4.68%.

articles.title: Target slips despite comparable-sales gains
bullets: Target shares declined 1.6% before the market opened Wednesday.
The retailer reported its second straight quarter of comparable-sales gains.
The stock moved lower despite signs of sales stabilization under CEO Michael Fiddelke.

articles.title: AP data shows CEO pay at top US companies rose 5.9% in 2025
bullets: AP analyzed compensation for CEOs of top US companies.
The data showed pay for the top jobs rose 5.9% in 2025.
The report lets readers compare CEO pay with their own compensation.

articles.title: US and Canada reach last-minute deal to delay tariffs, Trump says
bullets: Trump said the US and Canada reached a last-minute deal to delay tariffs.
The talks concerned tariffs on Canadian imports.
The delay reduced immediate pressure on cross-border trade.

articles.title: Amazon prepares major expansion of drone package delivery
bullets: Amazon plans to expand drone delivery of lightweight packages.
The service is expected to reach many more US cities.
The rollout is part of Amazon’s push for faster fulfillment.

articles.title: UAE trade suspension with Iran adds new business risk in Gulf
bullets: The UAE suspended trade with Iran after renewed missile fire.
The move affects regional commerce at a volatile moment for Gulf shipping.
Energy and trade markets are watching the Strait of Hormuz disruption.

articles.title: Oil price rise keeps inflation pressure on markets
bullets: Brent crude rose to $90.87 a barrel in Monday trading.
Higher oil prices pushed Treasury yields upward.
The move added pressure to stocks and inflation expectations.

articles.title: OpenAI introduces ChatGPT for Teens
bullets: OpenAI announced ChatGPT for Teens as a more age-appropriate chatbot experience.
The product is aimed at younger users and safety-focused interactions.
The launch comes amid growing scrutiny of AI tools used by minors.

articles.title: Meta trial puts families of social media victims at center of online safety fight
bullets: Families of social media victims are watching Meta’s trial as a pivotal online safety case.
The case focuses on alleged harms to young users.
The trial adds pressure on major platforms over child safety practices.

articles.title: Meta trial begins with states alleging platforms exploited young users’ vulnerability
bullets: State attorneys opened trial arguments against Meta.
They allege Meta platforms preyed on vulnerabilities of young brains.
The case is among the biggest legal fights over social media harms to children.

articles.title: AI-related stock selloff hits Wall Street
bullets: AI-related shares remained under pressure in US trading.
Oracle, Marvell, Intel and Micron were among premarket decliners Wednesday.
The selloff reflects investor concern over AI valuations and payoff timelines.

articles.title: Chinese robotics ambitions on display at world conference
bullets: China showcased robot dogs and helper robots at a major robotics conference.
The event highlighted the country’s push into humanoid and service robotics.
Investor interest in robotics remains strong as AI hardware advances.
